$comment: Ledger of known-failing frontend tests. It records reality; it is NOT permission to fail. This ledger may only shrink. Appending a new entry to make the gate pass is PROHIBITED — the correct response to a new failure is to fix the regression. When a listed test starts passing, the gate fails with STALE BASELINE until its entry is deleted from this file.

floor_lowered.reason: Deletion milestone, owner-authorised. Tests were removed because their subjects were removed (public funnel, collaboration layer, dead lib modules), not because a regression was hidden. The floor is reset to the newly MEASURED count so it continues to catch accidental test loss from here.

floor_raised_note: 2026-08-10 H1 loop: all 31 known failures fixed as stale-test drift (commits 1af8368ac, 36aa6fa6b, ecfbd3f63; adversarially verified, no weakened assertions). Floor raised 2119 -> 2440 to the newly measured count.
